profile.headline: IT Leader
profile.summary:
Performance-focused IT leader and Certified Scrum Master with a proven background driving large-scale Application Development, Operations Management, Procedure Development, Process Mapping, Database Design / Management, and Technology Migration initiatives for CNB, WiPro, Bank of Oklahoma, Bioeden, Inc., Seaway Two Corporation, and Megasys Hospitality Systems.

Demonstrates success within high-volume operations to achieve results while developing and implementing processes for systems and / or network growth and productivity to deliver services excellence with continued integrity to maximize the bottom line.

Offers broad experience in gathering, analyzing, and defining business and functional requirements, as well as leading key data modeling and process mapping, processes design / re-engineering, workflows, and technology solutions.

Actively collaborates with C-level executives, domestic / international IT and business associates, vendors, and clients to analyze needs, identify new IT / business opportunities, and attain leverage in critical markets.

*Applications*
SQL | SSIS | SSRS | MySQL | Apache | BluePrint RC
Visual Studio | TFS | Eclipse | UltraEdit | ProvideX
Microsoft Office | MuleSoft | NetOxygen
Subversion | Version Control | Microsoft Visio | Microsoft Project

*Languages*
C# | C++ | Visual Basic 
ProvideX | Business Basic
Java | SQL | HTML | PHP | JavaScript | Ajax

*Systems*
Windows
UNIX (Various Vendors
Linux (Various Distributions)

positions.title: Software Engineer V
positions.description: Provide leadership for a team of developers, working with architects to design the best solution for UI and backend.

positions.title: Programmer/Analyst Lead
positions.description: Provide leadership to an IT development team delivering quality solutions to business partners in the retail mortgage division.

positions.title: Senior Consultant
positions.description: Worked with business analysis team to deliver on requirement for client projects and for core application enhancements.

positions.title: Consulting Business Analyst
positions.description:
Capitalize on the opportunity to lead targeted business analysis initiatives for a multi-year project intended to replace LOS system for a Mortgage Division, including designing a pricing engine and an innovated solution for quoting private mortgage insurance rates.  Also provided an in system enhancement to dramatically improve image management performance..

Direct high-end line of business projects to support mortgage origination, mortgage servicing, and secondary marketing.

*Key Accomplishments*
•	Recognized for job performance excellence with rare promotion to Consulting Business Analyst at Bank of Oklahoma.
•	Successfully designed and developed pricing engine and cost-savings solution for quoting MI rates within NetOxygen.

positions.title: Chief Operating Officer | Chief Information Officer
positions.description:
Utilized broad scope of industry knowledge and dynamic business acumen toward directing operations across 2 U.S. – and U.K.-based client service hubs, including coordinating all IT, client services, accounting, and shipping / receiving efforts.

Facilitated strategic guidance as a Board of Directors’ member tasked with designing networking and application infrastructure, and further automated manual, time-consuming processes to drive gains in data tracking / accuracy.

Developed equipment maintenance and monitoring systems to interact with diverse pieces of data collection equipment, including developing webservices to provide consumer and partner websites with a robust API for interaction with the LMS.

*Key Accomplishments*
•	Designed and developed a comprehensive multilingual Laboratory Information Management System for Bioeden, Inc. to accurately maintain laboratory records and client records in an FDA-regulated environment, and further designed and developed a laboratory consumables tracking module integrated with LIMS for build of core materials inventory control.
•	Personally developed procedures to meet ISO-9001 standards to earn repeated certification via independent auditors.
•	Created a secure document control system to maintain confidential customer records electronically in conjunction with LIMS, and designed a multi-currency Accounts Receivable system integrated with Client Services portion of LIMS.
•	Migrated Legacy Systems to a modern infrastructure, including new hardware and OS, languages, and databases, as well as managing conversion of character-based reservation system to user-friendly GUI to enhance productivity.

positions.title: Director of Development
positions.description:
Contributed sharp analytical abilities toward delivering high-quality object-oriented analysis / design, coding, and testing of company’s proprietary property management software application to support efficient operations for multiple destination resorts, including effectively writing key specifications, test protocols, and user documentation.

Designed and developed document control system using mobile devices to provide sign-off and approved forms routing, along with performing process analysis to recommend and code changes in large-scale property systems.

*Key Accomplishments*
•	Developed a touch-screen Point-of-Sale System for retail and table service environments as Director of Development for Seaway Two Corporation, including supporting 20+ outlets and registering 1+ million transactions monthly.
•	Successfully designed a touch-screen appointment scheduling system that was integrated with the POS system, and further conceptualized and developed an inventory control system that was integrated with both previous systems.

positions.title: Vice President of Technology
positions.description:
Led targeted management of a details-driven programming and hardware support staff, including proactively analyzing user- and system-generated error reports to develop system development roadmap to ensure seamless technical efforts.

*Key Accomplishments*
•	Spearheaded the development of data migration tools for Megasys to convert client data from disparate systems, along with developing streamlined procedures to decrease labor time and reduce redundancies and creating and implementing automated system upgrade tools to manage enhancements to 100+ systems encompassing 5,000+ users.

positions.title: Lead Developer
positions.description: Played a vital role in delivering solutions-focused system maintenance and design for a large-scale property management system, including proactively supporting client installations nationwide to meet or exceed objectives.

volunteerExperiences.description: Coordinated volunteer efforts for interested employees in my department to support United Way.
